quiz.q: Which entity shows a less-than sign?
quiz.explain: `<` stands for "less than" and shows a <.

quiz.q: Which entity writes the copyright sign?
quiz.explain: `©` is the standard name. `©` also works.

exercise.task:
Fix up `index.html` using character references.

- Inside `<code>`, show the text `<h1>` (not a real heading).
- The paragraph with class `brand` must show `Tom & Jerry`; write the ampersand as `&`.
- The paragraph with class `math` must show `5 < 10`; write the less-than sign as `<`.
- The footer must show a copyright sign using `©`.
hints: The page will not show real tags, so the text you want must be written with entities instead of < and >.
Replace < with < and > with > inside the code element. Use & for the ampersand.

The page contains no real h1 element
checks.hint: Do not write a real <h1>. Use <h1> so it is only text.

checks.name: p.brand shows "Tom & Jerry"
checks.hint: The visible text must be Tom & Jerry.

checks.name: The ampersand is written as &
checks.hint: In the source, write the & as &.
